rows.title: Identification details takes its place in the linear journey after Commodity details
rows.detail: DR2.1 runs the journey page to page: Commodity details continues to Identification details when a selected species has identifier fields, Back returns to Commodity details, and Save and continue moves on to the next journey page. Today the page is reached only from the Overview task row, its Back link and Save and continue both go to the Overview, and a direct visit with nothing to identify lands on the Overview. Afterwards the page is a real journey step in the live-animals set that is skipped when there is nothing to identify, while the hub, review and template-review entry points keep returning where they came from.
acceptanceCriteria: When at least one selected species has identifier fields (such as cattle), 'Save and continue' on Commodity details goes to Identification details. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-010; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-068; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-017)

When no selected species has identifier fields (such as a fish-only consignment), 'Save and continue' on Commodity details skips Identification details and goes to the next journey page after it, and a direct GET or POST of the identification page redirects to that same next page, not to the Overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-011; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-009; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-004)

In the linear journey the page's 'Back' link goes to Commodity details. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-007; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-051; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-045)

When the page was opened from the Overview, Check your answers or template review, its 'Back' link follows the journey's back-link rule for that entry point, as the journey's other pages do. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-007; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-005)

In the live-animals linear journey, 'Save and continue' on a valid page goes to Additional details where that page applies to the consignment, otherwise to Arrival details. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-012; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-063; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-053)

When the page was opened from its Overview task, Check your answers or template review, 'Save and continue' on a valid page returns there instead. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-074; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)
notes: Unchanged by this re-distil. Combines three thin slices on the same page and the same flow entry (back link, entry into the step and skipping it, exit from the step): each needs the same flow change and the same journey walk to prove. req-201 is the live half only (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057); the germinal half belongs to the germinal-products area.

Keeps its existing dependencies: the rows that turn the linear journey into page-to-page navigation from Commodity details onwards (inc-001) and chain the commodity pages (inc-015). The tests repo's shared journey flow helper today expects the identification save to return to the Overview and must follow the new next page.

The template-review return is the journey's generic entry-point rule, applied in this page's controller; it changes no file the split-off type-question-and-templates theme owns (its check-answers/view-model/template-review folder), so it stays here.

rows.title: Selected commodities summary with a Species column, and identification grouped by commodity then species
rows.detail: DR2.1 adds a Species column to the Selected commodities summary and groups the identification panels into one section per commodity, headed '<commodity name> (<commodity code>)', with one panel per species inside it. Today the summary has no Species column, shows one row per commodity line, names the line 'Domestic cattle' in the summary but 'Cow' on its card, and heads each card '<name> (<code>) — <species>'. A species with no number of animals still gets a card with an uncapped counter today; DR2.1 gives it no panel until there is a number to count against.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Selected commodities' summary has one row per selected commodity with the columns 'Commodity code', 'Common name', 'Species' and 'Number of animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-035; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-048)

A commodity with several selected species, such as cats and dogs under 01061900, lists each species on its own line in its Species cell, and its quantity cell shows the row's number of animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-058)

A cattle line reads 'Cattle' in the summary's 'Common name' cell, and its identification section is headed 'Cattle (0102)'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-052; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-014)

Identification is shown as one section per commodity headed '<commodity name> (<commodity code>)', and inside it one panel per selected species with identifier fields, in selection order, each headed with the species name, such as 'Bos taurus'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-040, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-041; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-051)

A species with identifier fields but no number of animals gets no panel and no 'Enter details for <species>' form. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-041; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-063)
A live species with 3 animals takes exactly 3 entries, its form headed 'Enter details for <species> 1 of 3' for the first. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-043)

Lowering a species' number of animals below its saved records on Commodity details still shows the refusal, and its error summary link goes to that species' panel in its new place. (trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-061; conflicts:c-043)
rows.gate: Look at the commodity section and species panel structure: the per-species save, the germinal copy and the pig/sheep/goat rows all lay themselves out inside it.
notes: Unchanged by this re-distil. Combines the summary columns, the commodity/panel naming and the commodity-then-species grouping: all three change the same summary and panel structure on the same page and share one proof.

The several-species criterion is observable today: the live catalogue already carries cats and dogs under one commodity (01061900), so this row does not wait on the commodities row blocked on MDM (inc-012). Keep its dependency on inc-045 only.

The 'Number of packages' heading (req-1776) belongs to the germinal set's copy of this page (inc-052). The count-drop refusal on Commodity details (req-247, exists) links to the species panel, so its link target must still resolve to the new panel: the last criterion guards it, and it may touch the consignment-details error link.

rows.title: Each species panel saves only its own animal, with the saved-animals table below the form
rows.detail: In the live-animals set DR2.1 saves a multi-animal species one animal at a time through its own panel button, and the page's own buttons save only species with one animal. Today any save, the page's Save and continue included, validates every card and appends a record for every card that holds data, so one card's failure can leave earlier cards' records saved. DR2.1 also puts the saved-animals table under the form, shows only the table once every animal is entered (no completion message), and makes the panel button primary.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing a species panel's 'Save and add another' or 'Save and finish' validates and saves only that species' current animal, then reloads the page with that species' form empty for its next animal. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-051; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-022; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-063)

With an over-long value typed into a second species' form, pressing the first species' panel button saves the first species' animal and shows no error for the second species, whose typed value is not saved. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-051-m1, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-067; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-073)

'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview' save the typed identifiers of a species with one animal; values typed into the form of a species with more than one animal are not saved and do not appear in its saved-animals table when the page is opened again. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-054, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-055; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-072)

While a species still has animals to enter, its saved-animals table sits below the entry form and the panel button. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-063; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-061)

Once every animal of a species is entered, its panel shows only the saved-animals table: no entry form, no panel button, and no 'You have entered details for all …' message. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-048; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-061, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-055)
The panel's 'Save and add another' / 'Save and finish' button is a primary (green) button. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-055-m1)
The Welsh copy for this page no longer carries the removed 'You have entered details for all …' message, and stays a machine draft not shown to users. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-135)

rows.title: An empty species panel is refused on its own save, even beside a filled one
rows.detail: One identifier is enough to save a live animal (9 October ruling), but an animal with no identifier at all is not a record. Today 'Enter at least one identifier for this animal' fires only when nothing is typed anywhere on the page, so with two species an empty panel's save is skipped silently while the other's data is there. The check moves to each panel: a panel save with every identifier of its current animal blank is refused on that panel. The page's own 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview' still never block on missing identifiers, and the page still shows no message about the submit rule.
acceptanceCriteria: With cattle and dogs on the page, an ear tag typed into the cattle panel and nothing typed into the dog panel, pressing the dog panel's 'Save and add another' saves nothing and shows 'Enter at least one identifier for this animal' in the 'There is a problem' summary and inline on the dog panel's first identifier field; the summary link focuses that field. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-027, repo-frontend-p6-118; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p5-019; conflicts:c-042)

Pressing 'Save and finish' on a species' last animal still to enter, with every identifier of that animal blank, is refused the same way and the animal stays to enter. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-027; conflicts:c-042)

The per-panel check refuses only a wholly blank animal: a cow given only an ear tag and saved with its panel button saves with no error, is listed in the saved-animals table with an empty Passport cell, and the panel moves on to the next animal. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-019; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-102)

'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview' with every form on the page blank show no error, save no animal and move on. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-071; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-065; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-028; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-106)

rows.title: Identifier labels and hints follow DR2.1, length errors say 'or less', and values are trimmed before the length check
rows.detail: DR2.1 labels the microchip field 'Microchip', gives the text identifier fields no hints, and words the kept 58-character limit as '<label> must be 58 characters or less'. Today the field is 'Microchip number', each identifier has a 'For example, …' hint, the length errors say 'or fewer', and the limit is checked against the untrimmed value. The 58-character limit itself stays (c-040). Every English change is mirrored in the Welsh machine draft.
acceptanceCriteria: The microchip field is labelled 'Microchip', not 'Microchip number'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-052; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-024)

The Microchip, Passport, Tattoo and Ear tag fields show no hint text. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-024; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-054-m1; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-021, trace-e2e-p6-022, trace-e2e-p6-025, trace-e2e-p6-026)

An identifier over 58 characters shows, in the error summary and on the field, 'Microchip must be 58 characters or less', 'Passport must be 58 characters or less', 'Tattoo must be 58 characters or less', 'Ear tag must be 58 characters or less' or 'Horse name must be 58 characters or less'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-028; conflicts:c-040)

An identifier of 58 characters typed with spaces before and after it saves with no length error and reads back without the spaces. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-027; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-026-m1)

rows.title: Pigs, sheep and goats are identified by ear tag only
rows.detail: DR2.1 identifies pigs (0103), sheep (010410) and goats (010420) per animal by 'Ear tag' only. The real service does not offer these commodities: today's live-animal catalogue holds five commodities, none of them these. The 9 October afternoon ruling puts commodity catalogue work behind the MDM commodity integration, so this row waits until pigs, sheep and goats reach the catalogue from MDM; each selected pig, sheep or goat species then gets a panel asking for one ear tag per animal.
acceptanceCriteria: A selected pig species (0103) gets a panel asking for 'Ear tag' and no other identifier, once per animal. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-017)
A selected sheep (010410) or goat (010420) species gets a panel asking for 'Ear tag' and no other identifier, once per animal. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-021)

A pig, sheep or goat saved with an ear tag is listed in its saved-animals table, which has an 'Animal' column, an 'Ear tag' column and a 'Remove' action. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-017, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-021)
openQuestions: Blocked until commodities come from MDM: pigs (0103), sheep (010410) and goats (010420) join the live-animals catalogue only through the MDM commodity integration, which this programme cannot build. Whoever owns the MDM commodity integration must deliver it (and Sam rule the catalogue unblocked) before this row can be built (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 28, 29 and 32).
notes: Still blocked: req-219 and req-220 carry blockedBy (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-025 names inc-051 as waiting with the catalogue). Kept apart from the label/hint row so that row is not held up. Once unblocked it still waits for the commodities row that offers pigs, sheep and goats (inc-012) and for the grouping row whose panels it fills (inc-046).

Sources now cite the requirements' own ruling claims (p2-001, p2-024, p2-025). The ear tag is already stored by the backend, so no backend change is expected; the per-commodity identifier rules sit with the commodity obligations, which the commodities rows also change.

rows.title: The permanent address leaves the identification page
rows.detail: Today cat and dog panels carry a fraud warning, a permanent-address definition, the question 'Where will their permanent address be?' and eight address fields under the identifiers, validate them all-or-nothing, store the address on each animal and show it as a 'Permanent address' column. DR2.1 asks each animal's permanent address on its own permanent address page in consignment parties, so it leaves this page with its validation, its table column and its storage from here. The 2026-10-07 ruling is the fresh ruling DR1's address block waited for (c-044).
acceptanceCriteria: Cat and dog panels no longer show 'Providing a false address is an act of fraud', the permanent-address definition, the question 'Where will their permanent address be?' or any of its eight address fields. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-008; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-029; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-028)

A dog saved with microchip, passport and tattoo and no address saves with no address error; none of the address 'Enter …' or address length errors can appear on this page. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-044; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-036)
The cat and dog saved-animals table has no 'Permanent address' column. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-082; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-046)

A permanent address given on the permanent address page in consignment parties is still shown there after animals are saved or removed on this page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-008; conflicts:c-044)

The Welsh copy for this page no longer carries the removed address guidance, question, labels and errors, and stays a machine draft not shown to users. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-136, repo-frontend-p6-137)

rows.detail: The germinal products set's own copy of Identification details counts packages, not animals: its Selected commodities quantity column reads 'Number of packages' and shows each species' saved number of packages, where the live-animals page shows Number of animals. This is the one germinal requirement on this page's summary that the animal-identification area holds; the germinal-products area holds the rest of the germinal identification page.

rows.title: Germinal identification dates as single text inputs, with V4's date format, real-date and identification number length checks
rows.detail: On the germinal set's copy of the identification page, the collection and production dates are single text inputs with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026' that work without JavaScript, and the fields follow V4's date format, real-date and identification-number length rules. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds these now and leaves the 'Choose date' calendar (the MoJ date picker, req-253) waiting on design. No range rule applies to either date, and the production date is not checked against the collection date.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal products identification page, 'Collection date' and 'Production date' are each a single text input with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-023; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-021; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-068; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-092)

With JavaScript turned off, a trader can type both dates into their text inputs and save them, and they read back as typed. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-092)

A collection date and a production date in the past or in the future, and a production date earlier than the collection date, all save with no error. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-031)

An Identification number/mark of 59 characters shows 'Identification number/mark must be 58 characters or less' in the error summary and inline on the field; one of 58 characters saves. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-028; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

When a germinal save fails any of these rules, nothing is saved: opening the page again shows the values saved before, while the failing response keeps what was typed in the form. (conflicts:c-039; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-073)
